label: 水墨山角饰
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE standalone ink-light-watercolor MOUNTAIN CORNER ORNAMENT for Chinese tea-game UI. A low horizontal cluster of three overlapping softly contoured Jiangnan hills, tallest peak to left, sloping down towards right. Pale gray-sage wash and sparse delicate charcoal contour strokes, broad quiet smooth color areas, simplified soft internal folds, very light values so it won't overwhelm interface. Landscape1536x1024canvas, centered compact mountain patch occupying70%width35%height, complete contours and transparent margins. Transparent PNG without paper rectangle or sky. NO trees, houses, boats, birds, sun, river, ground slab, dense rock texture, noise, floating specks, muddiness, ambient fog, glow, text, labels or frame. Bottom may softly end in a thin sparse ink wash, no wide mist haze.
